book.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.overv: The $(item)Arcane Matrix Core$() is an endgame Source generator crafted with an Enchanting Apparatus. Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Source Gem Block frame around the core.$(br2)It starts automatically when at least one ring is complete and the minimum frame count is met. The other two rings may be expanded block by block to raise generation. Up to six Arcane Amplifiers can replace the axial vertices, adding 25% generation each.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.overv: The $(item)Arcane Mine$() converts Sourcestone and Source Gems into tagged ore blocks. Build complete 3, 5, 7, and 9-wide inverted-beacon layers above the core. An Arcane Amplifier may replace each layer center. A complete mine runs automatically unless its core receives a redstone signal.$(br2)With all four layers complete, its Source input range expands to 32 blocks by default and it can draw directly from loaded Matrix Cores. This search never loads additional chunks.$(br2)Hang ore blocks below completed layer corners for a whitelist, or below cardinal edge centers for a blacklist. Pale and dark-red beams show the active tuning.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.cycle: Use the Matrix to supply Source to both the Mine and an Imbuement Chamber, then have the Mine produce Lapis Ore. Break it with $(thing)Fortune$(), imbue each Lapis for 500 Source into a Source Gem, and return only enough gems to replenish the Mine's material points. The remaining Lapis does not need to be imbued.$(br2)This creates an automatable material loop, but mining and imbuement still consume Source generated by the Matrix.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine.ampli: Each successful cycle of a complete four-layer Mine has a 1% chance to produce one $(item)Arcane Amplifier$(); amplification never raises that amount or chance. Place at most one in each completed layer center to add one ordinary ore and raise Source and material costs by 50%.$(br2)Amplifiers that cannot be exported use a separate 64-item core buffer. Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_c: The Arcane Matrix Core is a Conduit-like Source generator. At least one complete 5 by 5 ring is required to start it; other valid frame blocks raise generation individually. Six Arcane Amplifiers may occupy its axial vertices, adding 25% generation each.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_m: The Arcane Mine is a Source-powered inverted-beacon multiblock. With all four layers complete, it draws from ordinary providers and loaded Matrix Cores within 32 blocks by default without loading new chunks. A redstone signal pauses it; center-column amplifiers increase output; ore samples hung below completed layers provide GUI-free whitelist and blacklist tuning.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_a: The Arcane Amplifier is a rare 1% byproduct of each successful cycle from a complete four-layer Arcane Mine. In a Matrix, replace up to six axial Source Gem Block vertices; each adds 25% of base Source generation. In a Mine, replace one center Source Gem Block per completed layer; each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. Amplifiers never improve their own drop chance or amount. Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable.
documentation.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_i: Place the Arcane Imbuement Core two to six blocks directly below an Imbuement Chamber. It pulls Source rapidly, supplies ordinary chamber recipes, and processes up to four compressed inputs in one five-second cycle by default. Lapis Blocks yield nine Source Gems each for 4,500 Source; Amethyst Blocks yield one Source Gem Block each for 2,000 Source. Empty-hand use toggles loose and compact output. Compact mode automatically converts every four buffered Source Gems into one Source Gem Block while preserving the remainder. Insert compressed inputs from the sides or top and extract completed products from the bottom. Starbuncles must use strict mode and target the bottom face when taking products. Redstone pauses all operation.
book.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_: Place the $(item)Arcane Imbuement Core$() two to six blocks directly below an Imbuement Chamber in the same column. Blocks and pipes may occupy the space between them.$(br2)The Core pulls Source from nearby providers, supplies the connected Chamber, and performs GUI-free bulk processing. Redstone pauses pulling and processing.

$(item)Bulk Imbuement$()$(br)Each five-second cycle processes up to four compressed inputs by default. Every Lapis Block costs 4,500 Source and yields nine Source Gems. Every Amethyst Block costs 2,000 Source and yields one Source Gem Block.$(br2)Use the Core with an empty hand to switch output mode. Loose mode keeps Source Gems separate. Compact mode converts every four buffered Source Gems into one Source Gem Block and retains zero to three loose Gems.$(br2)Insert from the sides or top and extract finished items from the bottom. Starbuncles taking products must use strict mode and target the bottom face.
A complete four-layer Arcane Mine has a 1% chance to produce one $(item)Arcane Amplifier$() after each successful cycle. Installed Amplifiers never raise their own byproduct chance or amount.$(br2)If the output is blocked, the Mine stores up to 64 Amplifiers in a separate internal buffer.

$(item)Arcane Matrix$()$(br)Replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of the unamplified generation rate, up to a total bonus of 150%.

$(item)Arcane Mine$()$(br)Replace the center Source Gem Block of each completed layer, up to four. Each Amplifier adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%. At four Amplifiers, ordinary output is 5x and costs are 3x.$(br2)Surplus Amplifiers are recyclable. See the following Imbuement Chamber recipe.

jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.info: Build a Conduit-like, three-axis 5 by 5 Source Gem Block frame around the core. It generates Source automatically when at least one ring is complete and the minimum frame count is met; the other two rings may be expanded block by block to raise generation.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.matrix_core.amplif: Any of the six axial vertices may be replaced with an Arcane Amplifier. Each adds 25% of base generation, for a total bonus of 150%.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.i: The Arcane Mine is an inverted-beacon multiblock built primarily from Sourcestone, with Source Gem Blocks at the center and four corners of each layer. The center Source Gem Block of a completed layer may be replaced with an Arcane Amplifier. Build complete 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, and 9x9 square layers in order above the core. The structure must remain continuously complete from the first layer.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.t: Hang ore blocks below the corners of completed layers to form a whitelist, or below the north, south, east, and west edge centers to form a blacklist. When a whitelist exists, only matching ores are selected; the blacklist always excludes matches afterward. Duplicate samples do not add weight, and samples on incomplete layers have no effect.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_mine_core.a: One Arcane Amplifier may occupy each completed layer center, up to four. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%. At full amplification, ordinary output is 5x and costs are 3x. Every successful cycle of a complete four-layer Mine has a 1% chance to produce one extra Amplifier, and that byproduct is never amplified.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.i: A rare byproduct with a 1% chance from each successful cycle of a complete four-layer Arcane Mine.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.m: In an Arcane Matrix: replace any of the six axial Source Gem Block vertices of the Conduit-like frame. No facing is required. Each Amplifier adds 25% of base Source generation, up to six for a total bonus of 150%.

In an Arcane Mine: place at most one in the center of each completed layer. Each adds one ordinary ore and raises Source and material costs by 50%, up to four. Amplifiers never increase the amount or chance of their own byproduct.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_amplifier.r: Recycling: use an Imbuement Chamber and 2,000 Source to recycle one Arcane Amplifier into four Source Gem Blocks.
jei.ars_arcane_matrix.arcane_imbuement_c: Place the Core two to six blocks directly below an Imbuement Chamber in the same X/Z column. Intermediate blocks may be used for pipes. The nearest valid Chamber is linked.
Bulk Lapis: each Lapis Block costs 4,500 Source and produces nine Source Gems. Up to four blocks are processed together in five seconds by default.
Bulk Amethyst: each Amethyst Block costs 2,000 Source and produces one Source Gem Block. Up to four blocks are processed together in five seconds by default.

The Core pulls up to 100,000 Source per second by default and actively pushes products downward. Insert compressed inputs from the sides or top. Starbuncles taking products must use strict mode and target the bottom face. Redstone pauses processing.
